name: posix_separator_only
description: Security-relevant near-miss: uses os.sep/os.altsep to detect path separators instead of literal '/' and '\\'. On a POSIX grading host, os.sep is '/' and os.altsep is None, so a backslash is never recognized as a separator and 'a\\b' (or a Windows-style traversal payload like '..\\..\\secret') is accepted unchanged instead of being rejected. A partial or platform-naive fix for path-separator rejection is realistically likely to make exactly this mistake.
